main.description: LangGraph actor disambiguation. For each VisionResult detection, search Wikidata SPARQL + GLEIF + OSM operator/owner tags + Murakumo LLM disambiguator → emit a candidate `did:web:maps.etzhayyim.com:registry:*:{code}` plus confidence. Strong matches get an `Operates` / `OwnsProperty` edge to the host Building vertex; weak matches stay as VisionResult-only. Graph entity + edge writes go via the etzhayyim substrate (AT MST + LanceDB per ADR-2605172000), not via PDS round-trip. PORT-adapted per ADR-2605214000 §2.

minConfidence.description: Skip emitting an edge below this confidence (default 0.7).

buildingVertexId.description: vertex_id of the linked Building, when known.

evidenceJson.description: Compact JSON of the disambiguation trace for audit.
